title: Flying a Kite
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George.
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治。

lines.en: This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig
Flying a kite.
It is a bright sunny day. Peppa and her family
lines.zh: 这是一个阳光灿烂的日子。佩奇和她的家人

lines.en: are in the park. They are going to fly a kite.
lines.zh: 在公园里。他们要去放风筝。

lines.en: George is going to fly the kite first.
George runs as fast as he can. But the kite won't fly.
lines.zh: 乔治尽可能快地跑。但风筝不会飞。

lines.en: George, you're doing it all wrong!
You didn't run fast enough. Now it's my turn.
lines.zh: 你跑得不够快。现在轮到我了。

lines.en: Peppa runs as fast as she can. But the kite still won't fly.
lines.zh: 佩奇尽可能快地跑。但风筝还是飞不起来。

lines.en: The kite won't fly if there isn't any wind, no matter how fast you run.
lines.zh: 如果没有风，无论你跑得多快，风筝也飞不起来。

lines.en: We just have to wait until the wind picks up a bit.
lines.zh: 我们只需要等到风刮起来就可以了。

lines.en: Look! It's getting windy!
Now that it is windy, the kite can fly.
lines.zh: 现在起风了，风筝可以飞了。

lines.en: The wind is quite strong now. The wind is very strong now.
lines.zh: 现在风很大。现在风很大。

lines.en: George!
Thank you Daddy!
Daddy Pig flies the kite.
Hurray!
Higher! Higher!
Daddy Pig flies the kite very well.
Wow!
Yes, I am a bit of an expert at these things.
lines.zh: 是的，我在这些方面有点专家。

lines.en: Watch out for the trees. You might get the kite stuck in one.
lines.zh: 小心树木。你可能会把风筝卡在其中。

lines.en: Don't worry. I know what I'm doing.
lines.zh: 别担心。我知道我在做什么。

lines.en: Oh dear. Daddy Pig has got the kite caught in a tree.
lines.zh: 哦天哪。猪爸爸把风筝挂在树上了。

lines.en: Oh no!
Don't worry, George. Daddy will get the kite down.
lines.zh: 别担心，乔治。爸爸会把风筝拿下来。

lines.en: Hurray!
Yes.
Careful! There's a big muddy puddle.
lines.zh: 小心！有一个很大的泥坑。

lines.en: Peppa and George love to jump in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢跳泥坑。

lines.en: Can we jump in the puddle? Please?
No, I don't want you covered in mud.
lines.zh: 不，我不想让你浑身是泥。

lines.en: Aww!
Stand back, children.
Please be careful, Daddy Pig.
I know what I'm doing.
Please be careful.
Just a bit further, Daddy.
Daddy Pig, you are much too heavy for that branch.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你对那个树枝来说太重了。

lines.en: Nonsense! I know exactly how heavy I am.
lines.zh: 废话！我清楚地知道我有多重。

lines.en: There.
Hurray!
Daddy Pig has rescued the kite.
Oh dear. Everyone is covered in mud.
lines.zh: 哦天哪。每个人都浑身是泥。

lines.en: It's only mud.
Luckily, Daddy Pig hasn't hurt himself.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，猪爸爸没有伤到自己。

lines.en: And the kite is out of the tree.
Hurray!
Mummy, now that we're all muddy, can we jump in the puddle?
lines.zh: 妈妈，现在我们都泥泞了，我们可以跳泥坑吗？

lines.en: I suppose so. After all, you can't get any muddier.
lines.zh: 我想是的。毕竟，你不能再浑浊了。

lines.en: And I think Daddy Pig is going to be doing the washing.
lines.zh: 我想猪爸爸会来洗衣服。

lines.en: Oh.
Peppa and George love jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢在泥坑里跳来跳去。

lines.en: Mummy and Daddy love jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 妈妈和爸爸最喜欢在泥坑里跳来跳去。

lines.en: Everyone loves jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢在泥坑里跳来跳去。

lines.en: Jumping up and down in muddy puddles is just as much fun as flying the kite.
lines.zh: 在泥坑里跳上跳下就像放风筝一样有趣。

lines.en: Peppa Pig.
Peppa Pig.
Peppa Pig.
